title: DREADVEIL
description: Dreadveil is a dark fantasy RPG modpack for Minecraft 1.20.1, built around immersive exploration, atmospheric worldbuilding, and player freedom
body:
**DREADVEIL**
Dreadveil is a dark fantasy RPG modpack built for players who want more than just survival. It transforms Minecraft into a world of forgotten history, cursed beauty, and endless possibility.

**Explore a handcrafted-feeling world filled with**

† towering mountains and dense ancient forests

† ruined castles, forgotten churches, and hidden crypts

† vampiric powers, dark rituals, and dangerous creatures

† immersive building, cozy interiors, and roleplay freedom

**Whether you choose to**

† become a creature of the night,

† hunt monsters through cursed ruins,

† build a hidden sanctuary in the woods,

† or simply explore a world full of stories…

_Dreadveil lets you shape your own path._

**Features**

† cinematic terrain generation

† medieval / gothic structures

† immersive sound and shaders

† custom combat and RPG progression

† dark fantasy creatures and events

† furniture, decor, and building freedom

† backpacks, quests, and exploration tools

**Recommended**

_Use shaders for the full experience. Play with friends for co-op exploration_

**MINIMUM / RECOMMENDED SPECS**

**MINIMUM**

♡ low settings

♡ 8–10 render distance

♡ Ryzen 5 2600 / Intel i5-9400F or similar

♡ GTX 1060 6GB / RX 580 or better

♡ 6–8 GB Minecraft RAM allocation

**RECOMMENDED**

♡ Ryzen 5 5600 / Intel i5-12400F or better

♡ RTX 2060 / RTX 3060 / RX 6600 XT+

♡ 8–10 GB Minecraft RAM allocation

_Designed For ❀ Dark fantasy fans ❀ Explorers ❀ Builders ❀ RPG / roleplay players ❀ Multiplayer with friends_
